questions.questionText: Transact-SQL programming is:
options: A procedural language extension to SQL
questions.correctAnswer: A procedural language extension to SQL
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: A procedural language extension to SQL.

questions.questionText: A batch is:
options: A group of one or more Transact-SQL statements sent to the server together
questions.correctAnswer: A group of one or more Transact-SQL statements sent to the server together
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: A group of one or more Transact-SQL statements sent to the server together.

questions.questionText: Which command signals the end of a batch to SQL Server tools?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: GO.

questions.questionText: If a batch has a syntax error in one statement, what happens?
options: The whole batch is not executed
questions.correctAnswer: The whole batch is not executed
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: The whole batch is not executed.

questions.questionText: Which statements must be the first statement in a batch?
options: CREATE statements such as CREATE VIEW or CREATE PROCEDURE
questions.correctAnswer: CREATE statements such as CREATE VIEW or CREATE PROCEDURE
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: CREATE statements such as CREATE VIEW or CREATE PROCEDURE.

questions.questionText: It is recommended to terminate Transact-SQL statements with:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: A semicolon.

questions.questionText: Which statement declares a variable?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: DECLARE.

questions.questionText: Which data types cannot be used for a variable?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: text, ntext, and image.

questions.questionText: Which two methods can assign a value to a variable?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: SET and SELECT.

questions.questionText: SET can assign from a query only when the query returns:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: A scalar value.

questions.questionText: If a SELECT assignment query returns no rows, the variable:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: Retains its previous value.

questions.questionText: A synonym is:
options: An alternative name for a database object
questions.correctAnswer: An alternative name for a database object
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: An alternative name for a database object.

questions.questionText: Which statement creates a synonym?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: CREATE SYNONYM.

questions.questionText: Which statement removes a synonym?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: DROP SYNONYM.

questions.questionText: A synonym can be modified using:
options: DROP and CREATE, since there is no ALTER SYNONYM
questions.correctAnswer: DROP and CREATE, since there is no ALTER SYNONYM
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: DROP and CREATE, since there is no ALTER SYNONYM.

questions.questionText: Synonyms provide a layer of abstraction that:
options: Protects client applications from changes to the name or location of the base object
questions.correctAnswer: Protects client applications from changes to the name or location of the base object
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: Protects client applications from changes to the name or location of the base object.

questions.questionText: Which constructs are control-of-flow statements in Transact-SQL?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: IF...ELSE, WHILE, BEGIN...END.

questions.questionText: BEGIN and END are used to:
options: Group multiple statements into a block
questions.correctAnswer: Group multiple statements into a block
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: Group multiple statements into a block.

questions.questionText: The IF...ELSE construct is used to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: Execute statements conditionally.

questions.questionText: The WHILE loop executes statements:
options: Only when the condition is false
Repeatedly as long as the condition is true
questions.correctAnswer: Repeatedly as long as the condition is true
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: Repeatedly as long as the condition is true.

questions.questionText: Which statement exits a WHILE loop immediately?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: BREAK.

questions.questionText: Which statement skips to the next iteration of a WHILE loop?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: CONTINUE.

questions.questionText: Which statement unconditionally exits from a query or procedure?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: RETURN.

questions.questionText: Which statement delays execution for a specified time?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: WAITFOR.

questions.questionText: The CASE expression is used to:
options: Evaluate conditions and return one of several possible results
questions.correctAnswer: Evaluate conditions and return one of several possible results
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: Evaluate conditions and return one of several possible results.

questions.questionText: Which statement jumps to a label?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: GOTO.

questions.questionText: A deterministic function:
options: Returns the same result every time it is called with the same input values
questions.correctAnswer: Returns the same result every time it is called with the same input values
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: Returns the same result every time it is called with the same input values.

questions.questionText: Which function is non-deterministic?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: GETDATE().

questions.questionText: Which function is deterministic?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: DAY().

questions.questionText: User-defined functions (UDFs) are:
options: Routines that accept parameters, perform an action, and return a result or table
questions.correctAnswer: Routines that accept parameters, perform an action, and return a result or table
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: Routines that accept parameters, perform an action, and return a result or table.

questions.questionText: A scalar-valued function:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: Returns a single value.

questions.questionText: A table-valued function:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: Returns a table data type.

questions.questionText: Which statement creates a user-defined function?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: CREATE FUNCTION.

questions.questionText: Which statement modifies a user-defined function?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: ALTER FUNCTION.

questions.questionText: Which statement removes a user-defined function?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: DROP FUNCTION.

questions.questionText: A window function is applied using which clause?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: OVER.

questions.questionText: The three core components of a window defined with OVER are:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: Partitioning, ordering, and framing.

questions.questionText: Which OVER subclause divides the rows into groups?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: PARTITION BY.

questions.questionText: Which function assigns a unique sequential number to each row within a partition?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: ROW_NUMBER().

questions.questionText: RANK() differs from DENSE_RANK() in that RANK():
options: Leaves gaps in ranking after ties
questions.correctAnswer: Leaves gaps in ranking after ties
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: Leaves gaps in ranking after ties.

questions.questionText: Which function distributes rows into a specified number of groups?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: NTILE().

questions.questionText: Which analytic function returns a value from a previous row?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: LAG().

questions.questionText: Which analytic function returns a value from a following row?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option B: LEAD().

questions.questionText: Ranking functions are also called:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: Window ranking functions.

questions.questionText: In batches, variables declared are:
options: Local to the batch in which they are declared
questions.correctAnswer: Local to the batch in which they are declared
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: Local to the batch in which they are declared.

questions.questionText: Which function returns the current system date and time?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: GETDATE().

questions.questionText: Which function returns the length of a string?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: LEN().

questions.questionText: Which function returns the leftmost characters of a string?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option C: LEFT().

questions.questionText: Which function adds an interval to a date?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: DATEADD().

questions.questionText: Which function returns the difference between two dates?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: DATEDIFF().

questions.questionText: Which function converts one data type to another?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option A: CAST() or CONVERT().

questions.questionText: An inline table-valued function:
options: Is not allowed in SQL Server
Returns a table from a single SELECT statement
questions.correctAnswer: Returns a table from a single SELECT statement
questions.explanation: Correct answer is option D: Returns a table from a single SELECT statement.
